title: Ngarava and Muzarabani pose India's next hard-length test
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Richard Ngarava and Blessing Muzarabani are currently operating at the peak of their powers. Zimbabwe’s seam attack has ranked among the best of the 12 Full Member teams at home since the start of 2025, and the two quicks have been at the forefront of that rise.

Adding to this, Ngarava belongs to a select group of specialist fast-bowling captains, only the second for his country after Heath Streak, who captained in 21 Tests and 68 ODIs between 2000 and 2004.Muzarabani, meanwhile, became only the fourth Zimbabwe cricketer to play in the IPL earlier this year after being a part of the RCB setup during their victorious 2025 campaign as a replacement for Lungi Ngidi.

Meanwhile, The two form the core of the seam bowling attack, and have been influential in their side’s scattered success in recent times, at times leading the way individually or as a pair, or playing second-fiddle to Sikandar Raza and others.
Notably, The duo's peak comes at an interesting time for India. Their recent struggles against hard lengths were exposed in Ireland and England, where longer boundaries aided the bowlers.

As per the latest buzz, Both Muzarabani and Ngarava are good exponents of the same, given their height and high rollout points, and that could be the key battle in the soon-to-release series. More on that later.

In further updates, The duo has bagged 78 wickets together in Tests wherein they have both opened the bowling, 62 in ODIs and 98 in T20Is. On that front, they form Zimbabwe’s most successful bowling pair in each of the three formats. They have collectively bagged 32 of the 59 wickets across their last three Test wins (two against Bangladesh and one against Afghanistan).

On top of that, Since the start of 2025, Zimbabwe seam attack ranks fourth in terms of averages in home T20Is among the 12 full-member teams, and fifth in both Tests and ODIs. That’s a significant standing for a team that’s ranked 10th in Tests, 11th in ODIs and 12th in T20Is. Muzarabani and Ngarava have been at the forefront, with excellent numbers across formats (and across conditions) in the time-frame.

Adding to this, The Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, came into force on June 29, 2026, replacing the scheme that had been in force since 1952.
Meanwhile, Existing members will continue under the EPF Scheme, 2026 without fresh enrolment or migration.
Notably, The statutory contribution rate remains 12 per cent of wages each for the employer and employee; specified establishments will continue at 10 per cent.
As per the latest buzz, The statutory wage ceiling remains Rs 15,000 per month.
In further updates, Portability through the Universal Account Number (UAN), nomination facility, the EPF interest rate, and the retirement age also remain unchanged.
On top of that, Employees earning Rs 15,000 or less must contribute 12 per cent of wages where EPF applies.
Based on the statutory ceiling, the minimum monthly contribution is Rs 1,800 each for the employee and employer.

title: ‘ഒരു കുടുംബത്തിന്റെ പ്രതീക്ഷകളാണ് ഇവിടെ നഷ്ടപ്പെടുന്നത്’; കൃഷ്ണകുമാറിനെ തള്ളി അഹാന
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
Published: July 23, 2026 02:33 PM IST Updated: July 23, 2026 03:54 PM IST

Adding to this, നീറ്റ് പരീക്ഷാ നടത്തിപ്പിലെ ക്രമക്കേടുകളിൽ പ്രതിഷേധിച്ച് ഡൽഹി ജന്തർ മന്തറിൽ സമരം ചെയ്ത വിദ്യാർഥികളെ ഡൽഹി പൊലീസും റാപ്പിഡ് ആക്‌ഷൻ ഫോഴ്സും ചേർന്ന് അടിച്ചമർത്തിയ നടപടിക്കെതിരെ രാജ്യവ്യാപകമായി വൻ പ്രതിഷേധം ഉയരുകയാണ്. എന്നാൽ ഭരണകൂട നടപടികളെയും പൊലീസിന്റെ അടിച്ചമർത്തലിനെയും ന്യായീകരിക്കുന്ന രീതിയിലായിരുന്നു കൃഷ്ണകുമാറിന്റെ സോഷ്യൽ മീഡിയ പോസ്റ്റ്. പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി നരേന്ദ്ര മോദിയുടെ ചിത്രം പങ്കുവച്ചുകൊണ്ട് ‘കശ്മീരിലെ കല്ലേറ് നിർത്താൻ അറിയാമെങ്കിൽ... പിന്നെയാ ഡൽഹി...’ എന്നായിരുന്നു കൃഷ്ണകുമാർ കുറിച്ചത്.

Meanwhile, സ്വന്തം പൗരന്മാരുടെയും വിദ്യാർഥികളുടെയും ന്യായമായ ആവശ്യങ്ങളെ അടിച്ചമർത്തുന്നതിനെ പിന്തുണച്ച കൃഷ്ണകുമാറിനെതിരെ സോഷ്യൽ മീഡിയയിൽ കടുത്ത വിമർശനവും ജനരോഷവുമാണ് ഉയർന്നത്. കൃഷ്ണകുമാറിനെതിരെ ഈ രീതിയിൽ വിമർശനങ്ങൾ ശക്തമായി തുടരുന്നതിനിടയിലാണ്, സ്വന്തം അച്ഛന്റെ നിലപാടുകളെ പൂർണ്ണമായും തള്ളിക്കളയുന്ന രീതിയിൽ വിദ്യാർഥികളുടെയും അവരുടെ കുടുംബങ്ങളുടെയും വേദന പങ്കുവച്ചുകൊണ്ട് അഹാന കൃഷ്ണ രംഗത്തെത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നത്.
Notably, വിദ്യാർഥികൾ നേരിടുന്ന മാനസിക സംഘർഷങ്ങളെയും ഭരണകൂട സംവിധാനങ്ങളുടെ വീഴ്ചകളെയും രൂക്ഷമായ ഭാഷയിൽ വിമർശിക്കുന്ന അഹാനയുടെ കുറിപ്പ് ഇങ്ങനെ:

As per the latest buzz, ‘‘തങ്ങളുടെ നിയന്ത്രണത്തിലല്ലാത്ത കാര്യങ്ങൾ കാരണം ഒരു കുട്ടിയുടെ പ്രതീക്ഷകൾ തകർന്നടിയ��ന്നത് കാണുന്നത് തികച്ചും വേദനാജനകമാണ്. ഓരോ പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് പിന്നിലും നമ്മൾ എപ്പോഴും കാണാത്ത ഒരു കഥയുണ്ട് - വർഷങ്ങളുടെ തയാറെടുപ്പുകൾ, ത്യാഗങ്ങൾ, കഠിനാധ്വാനം നമ്മെ എവിടെയെങ്കിലും എത്തിക്കുമെന്ന ഉറച്ച വിശ്വാസം. ഓരോ വാർത്താ തലക്കെട്ടുകൾക്ക് പിന്നിലും നിഷ്കളങ്കമായ സ്വപ്നങ്ങളുള്ള കുറച്ച് ചെറുപ്പക്കാരും, അവരുടെ മികച്ചൊരു ഭാവി പ്രതീക്ഷിച്ചു കഴിയുന്ന കുടുംബങ്ങളുമുണ്ട്.

In further updates, വർഷങ്ങളോളം പരീക്ഷയ്ക്കായി തയാറെടുത്തിട്ട്, പരീക്ഷയുടെ തലേദിവസം അത് റദ്ദാക്കപ്പെട്ടപ്പോൾ തളർന്നുപോയ സുഹൃത്തുക്കളെ ഞാൻ വളരെ അടുത്തറിഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ട്. അത് എത്രത്തോളം ദാരുണമാണെന്നും, അത് അവരുടെ പ്ലാനുകളെ മാത്രമല്ല, നീതിയെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള അവരുടെ സങ്കൽപ്പങ്ങളെത്തന്നെ എങ്ങനെയൊക്കെയാണ് തകർത്തു കളയുന്നതെന്നും ഞാൻ കണ്ടിട്ടുണ്ട്.

On top of that, എല്ലാവർക്കും ഇത് ഒരുപോലെയല്ല. സാമ്പത്തിക ഭദ്രതയുള്ള ഒരു കുടുംബത്തിലെ കുട്ടിയെ സംബന്ധിച്ച് തിരിച്ചടികൾ കേവലം ഒരു തിരിച്ചടി മാത്രമായിരിക്കാം. എന്നാൽ വളരെ പരിമിതമായ സാഹചര്യങ്ങളിൽ ജീവിക്കുന്ന ഒരു കുടുംബത്തിലെ കുട്ടിയെ സംബന്ധിച്ച്, അവരുടെ ജീവിതം തന്നെ മാറ്റിമറിക്കാൻ സാധിക്കുമെന്ന് വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന ഒരേയൊരു വഴിയാണ് വിദ്യാഭ്യാസം. ആ വിശ്വാസം തകരുമ്പോൾ, അവിടെ നഷ്ടപ്പെടുന്നത് വെറുമൊരു പരീക്ഷ മാത്രമല്ല... ഒരു കുടുംബത്തിന്റെ പ്രതീക്ഷകൾ കൂടിയാണ്.

ഇത്തരം വീഴ്ചകൾക്ക് ഉത്തരവാദികളായവർ ആരായാലും, യാതൊരു ഇളവുകളുമില്ലാതെ അവർ വിചാരണ ചെയ്യപ്പെടുകയും ശിക്ഷിക്കപ്പെടുകയും വേണം. സുതാര്യവും നീതിയുക്തവും തങ്ങളുടെ വിശ്വാസത്തിന് അർഹവുമായ ഒരു സംവിധാനം നമ്മുടെ കുട്ടികൾ അർഹിക്കുന്നുണ്ട്. ഒരു കുട്ടിക്കും ഇനി ഇത്തരം ഭാരങ്ങൾ പേറേണ്ടി വരില്ലെന്ന് ഞാൻ ആത്മാർഥമായി ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു... ഒരിക്കൽ നൽകിയ പ്രതീക്ഷകൾ ഇത്ര എളുപ്പത്തിൽ ഇല്ലാതാകാതിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു നാളേക്ക് വേണ്ടി,’’– അഹാന കൃഷ്ണ കുറിച്ചു.

body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Tip Us Dismiss News Banner Breaking News Venice Movie Festival Lineup Announcement — Follow Live Read the full story Home International News Sony LIV Welcomes Graphic India’s Animated Series ‘The Legend Of Karna’ By Jesse Whittock
Adding to this, EXCLUSIVE: Sony LIV is getting deeper into the animation game.

Meanwhile, The India-based streamer has quietly greenlit The Legend of Karna , which comes from Sharad Devarajan and Jeevan J. Kang and their production house, Graphic India . The series, inspired by the Hindu epic Mahabharata, will debut on July 31.

Notably, The Legend of Karna will follow Karna, a warrior from the Mahabharata who is born to Kunti and the Sun God Surya but raised in a charioteer's household. He possesses the gift of bow mastery that rivals the greatest warriors of his age, compelling him to enter a grand tournament usually reserved only for kings and princes, altering the course of an empire forever. Related Stories Acquisitions Sony LIV Lands Aamir Khan's Feel-Good Basketball Comedy-Drama 'Sitaare Zameen Par' News 'Real Kashmir Football Club' Adds The Drama To A 'Welcome To Wrexham'-Like Story From India - Global Breakouts

As per the latest buzz, Per the synopsis: “Crowned king by the ambitious prince Duryodhana but rejected by a court that judges him by his perceived birth, Karna rises from the dust of a village workshop to the royal halls of Hastinapura. His journey is one of exceptional talent, unwavering loyalty and an enduring struggle against a world governed by lineage. As politics, prophecy and hidden truths converge, Karna must confront the conflict between the destiny imposed upon him and the legacy he seeks to create.” Watch on Deadline

In further updates, “We couldn’t imagine a better home for this journey than with our partners at Sony LIV and the incredible honor they are giving us,” shared Devarajan, the co-creator and showrunner. “Karna has always been the tragic heart of the Mahabharata. What the world refused him by birth, his own hands took with skill, and that question feels more urgent today than ever. Does greatness come from where you are born, or from what you do?

On top of that, “With The Legend of Karna, we wanted to tell his story the way it deserves to be told, as an epic saga of unbreakable loyalty, unbearable secrets, and a talent that shook the world, seen through the eyes of a hero who has always stood at the center of the epic but never at the center of its telling.”

Devarajan is known for collaborating with the late Stan Lee, collaborating to create Indian superhero series Chakra – The Invincible for Cartoon Network India in 2013. The Marvel creator’s influence on Devarajan was such that in the past he has been called “the Indian Stan Lee.” His credits include producing Netflix live-action movie The Archies and The Legend of Hanuman , which has become one of the top-rated series on Disney+ Hotstar. Devarajan also created the Spider-Man India character for Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse , and teamed with SS Rajamouli on the Baahubali movie franchise, overseeing gaming, publishing and digital media and creating Prime Video series Baahubali: The Lost Legends .

Meanwhile, झिम्बाब्वेविरुद्धच्या पहिल्या टी-20 सामन्यात भारतासाठी अभिषेक शर्मा आणि वैभव सूर्यवंशी डावाची सुरुवात करतील. संघात प्रभसिमरन सिंगच्या रूपात आणखी एक सलामीवीर आहे, परंतु प्रभसिमरनला बेंचवर बसावे लागू शकते. पाचव्या क्रमांकापर्यंतचा फलंदाजीचा क्रम निश्चित झाला आहे, ज्यामध्ये यष्टीरक्षक-फलंदाज ईशान किशन तिसऱ्या क्रमांकावर, कर्णधार श्रेयस अय्यर चौथ्या क्रमांकावर आणि उपकर्णधार तिलक वर्मा पाचव्या क्रमांकावर असेल.

Notably, रिंकू सिंग या मालिकेसाठी भारतीय संघात परतला आहे, परंतु त्याला अंतिम अकरा खेळाडूंमध्ये स्थान मिळण्याची शक्यता कमी आहे. शिवम दुबे सहाव्या क्रमांकावर आणि सूर्यांश शेडगे सातव्या क्रमांकावर खेळण्याची शक्यता आहे. दोघेही गोलंदाजी करतात, त्यामुळे त्यांना संधी मिळण्याची अधिक शक्यता आहे.

title: Kia Syros EV launched in India at Rs. 13.49 lakh
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

AD Kia Syros EV launched in India at Rs. 13.49 lakh Haji Chakralwale July 23, 2026, 02:21 PM IST 9,957 Views Offered with two battery pack options and up to 526km claimed range Prices go up to Rs. 19.99 lakh (ex-showroom) Kia India has finally taken the wraps off the all-electric Syros in the country, making it the brand's second locally made EV after the Carens Clavis EV. Prices start at Rs. 13.49 lakh (ex-showroom) for the entry-level 42kWh variant, while the larger 51.4kWh Extended Range version starts at Rs. 16.99 lakh. The top-spec X-Line ER is priced at Rs. 19.99 lakh, with deliveries set to commence from 30 July.

Adding to this, At first glance, the Syros EV looks familiar, and that's because Kia hasn't strayed too far from the ICE model. The overall shape remains unchanged, but a handful of EV-specific touches help it stand apart. There's a closed-off Digital Tiger Face, redesigned bumpers, Ice Cube LED headlamps, Star Map lighting elements, aero-optimised alloy wheels, and flush-fitting door handles. Kia is also offering the electric SUV in nine exterior colours, including an exclusive Matte Graphite shade reserved for the X-Line.

Meanwhile, The cabin, too, mirrors the standard Syros, although it packs in everything buyers would expect from a premium electric SUV. Dominating the dashboard is Kia's 30-inch Trinity display that combines the digital instrument cluster, infotainment touchscreen, and climate control interface into one seamless layout. Other notable features include wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, a Harman Kardon eight-speaker audio system, ventilated front and rear seats, a panoramic sunroof, powered driver's seat, ambient lighting, a wireless charger, and even a 16-litre frunk.

Notably, The Syros EV can be had with either a 42kWh or a 51.4kWh battery pack. The former offers a claimed range of 443km, while the larger unit stretches that figure to 526km on a full charge. Kia says this also makes the Syros EV the first model in its segment to deliver more than 500km of certified range and with the larger battery, the SUV can sprint from 0-100kmph in a claimed 8.1 seconds. Charging from 10 to 80 per cent using a 100kW DC fast charger takes 39 minutes.

As per the latest buzz, Safety hasn't taken a back seat either. The Syros EV comes equipped with six airbags, Level 2 ADAS with 16 autonomous driving functions, a 360-degree camera, blind view monitor, front, rear and side parking sensors, ESC, hill start assist, electronic parking brake with auto hold, tyre pressure monitoring, and ISOFIX child seat mounts.

In further updates, Perhaps the bigger talking point is Kia's ownership package. Alongside the launch, the company has introduced a 15-year unlimited-kilometre warranty on the high-voltage battery for the first owner, an assured buyback programme promising up to 80 per cent resale value after three years, Battery-as-a-Service (BaaS) finance options, and access to the K-Charge network with more than 20,300 charging points across India. It's a move that aims to address some of the biggest concerns around EV ownership beyond just the purchase price.

title: Rubio says Iran ‘begging’ for a deal with US but not ready to make one
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

x whatsapp-stroke copylink google Add Al Jazeera on Google info US Secretary of State Marco Rubio speaks to the news media on the sidelines of a foreign ministers meeting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations in Pasay, Metro Manila [Brendan Smialowski/AFP] By Heba Habib Published On 23 Jul 2026 23 Jul 2026 United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio says Iran is privately pressing Washington for a deal to end the war but Tehran is not yet “ready” to accept one,

Adding to this, “Iran is begging us, both directly and indirectly, ‘Let’s do a deal. Let’s talk,'” Rubio shared, in conversation with reporters on the sidelines of an Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) meeting of foreign ministers in Manila, Philippines, on Thursday.

Meanwhile, “The problem with Iran is every time they make a deal, the people in charge either break it or they want to change it. So it looks like they’re not ready to make a deal, so they’re going to continue to pay a price, and every night the price gets higher and higher.”
Notably, Rubio described Iran as “a country run by radical clerics”, calling them “oblivious” to its economic problems.

As per the latest buzz, “Iran can be the richest country in the Middle East if they wanted to be. But instead, they take their money, and they use it and they give it to Hezbollah. They give it to Hamas. They give it to the Houthis. They give it to Shia militias. They give it to sponsored terrorism all over the world,” he shared, referring to Tehran-aligned or -supported groups in the region.

In further updates, Asked about Iranian officials who have described their military policy with the US as “an eye for an eye”, Rubio shared US President Donald Trump’s approach was “a head for an eye”.

On top of that, Iran “will pay a very heavy price for the things they are doing. They are already paying a heavy price,” he shared, claiming Iran’s industrial infrastructure was being “decimated”, resulting in “billions” of dollars in damage.

Washington’s central objective, Rubio shared, remained a denuclearised Iran. “Our number one interest and the threat they pose to the world is these lunatics in possession of a nuclear weapon , and that’s not going to happen,” he shared.

Following Scam 1992: The Harshad Mehta Story (2020) and Scam 2003: The Telgi Story (2023), filmmaker Hansal Mehta is nearing completion of the franchise’s third instalment, Scam 2010: The Subrata Roy Saga .

Adding to this, Scam franchise director and showrunner Hansal Mehta, Subrata Roy Sahara and star Siddharth Bodke The series traces the rise and fall of controversial Sahara India Pariwar founder Subrata Roy Sahara , who spent over two years in jail in connection with the long-running SEBI-Sahara investor refund case.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Siddharth Bodke (@siddharthbodkeofficial)

Notably, Marathi star Siddharth Bodke plays Roy, while Kritika Singh and Moon Banerjee portray his wife Swapna Roy and mother Chhabi Roy, respectively. Aditya Srivastava is also part of the cast. The series is based on Tamal Bandyopadhyay’s book, Sahara: The Untold Story .

As per the latest buzz, “The team shot in Lucknow, where Sahara’s head office is based, as well as in Kanpur-Bithoor, Malihabad and other nearby locations. After completing schedules in Noida, Delhi and Dehradun, they are now shooting the final leg in Mumbai. The working title for now it Scam 2010.” a source tells us. Roy passed away on 14 November 2023, at age 75. He founded the business conglomerate Sahara India Pariwar in 1978 and in 2004, the Sahara group was termed by Time magazine as “the second largest employer in India after Indian Railways”.

title: Twinkle Khanna speaks out CJP protests, says she is proud to belong to a country where youth has the courage to dissent
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Twinkle Khanna has spoken in solidarity with the students protesting in India. What Twinkle shared Twinkle shared several images taken during the ongoing protests in Delhi and Mumbai in her new post. The first image was of Rhiya Ahir , a 27-year-old model, who became one of the defining faces of the protest at Shivaji Park on Wednesday. She stood blocking a police van that was carrying protesters who were detained during demonstrations demanding the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over alleged examination irregularities. Another picture showed a woman shielding other protestors from getting lathi-charged by the Delhi Police.

Adding to this, In the caption, Twinkle wrote, "Proud to belong to a country where our young people still have the courage to dissent, to push back, to brave tear gas and batons. The sad part is that they have to."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Twinkle Khanna (@twinklerkhanna)

Notably, Over the past few days, several celebrities have spoken in solidarity with the students. Shabana Azmi, Prakash Raj were seen in Jantar Mantar and attended the Chalo Sansad march. Several names including Sonakshi Sinha, Salman Khan , Alia Bhatt, Imran Khan and Rajkummar Rao have shown support through social media posts.

As per the latest buzz, Students, parents and supporters have gathered at Delhi's Jantar Mantar and in several other cities, demanding accountability and reforms. The movement is being led by the satirical Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), which emerged after Chief Justice of India Surya Kant allegedly referred to unemployed youth activists as "cockroaches." Protesters later adopted the term themselves, turning it into a symbol of resistance.

In further updates, Among the key demands are the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, ₹ 1 crore rupees compensation for the families of students who died by suicide, and the rollout of activist Sonam Wangchuk.

On top of that, The movement gained further attention during the July 20 'Chalo Sansad' march in Delhi. Although the protest started peacefully, clashes later broke out between a section of protesters and the police, leading authorities to use tear gas and batons. Demonstrations have continued since then, with protesters saying they will not stop until they see accountability, justice, and meaningful reforms to the examination system.

title: Imran Khan's take on actors who stay apolitical amid student protests: 'Your art has no value'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After showing support for the CJP -led student protest on social media, Bollywood star Imran Khan took to the streets of Mumbai to participate in a protest march in solidarity with the students protesting in Delhi. During the march, Imran was asked about actors who refuse to support such movements and claim that art should remain apolitical.

Adding to this, Imran Khan spotted at the protest site in Mumbai with a bunch of young students. 'Your art has no value' During the protest, Imran was asked by an aspiring star if he had anything to say to actors who believe that art is not political. Responding to the question, Imran shared, "True art is going to have an individual artist point of you embedded within it, and as part of our human nature, we are going to have opinion and perspective that we hold through to ourselves . If you can’t stand by your opinions and if you do not pour your own heart into your art, your art has no value."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Riya Jana (@_jana_riya_)

Notably, A day earlier, Imran had expressed his support for the student protest on social media. He voiced his discontent over the alleged use of lathi-charge against students, saying that the very system meant to protect and support them had already failed them. He wrote, “Something broke in me today. Watching as police gassed and battered student protestors… how could I make sense of this? These students who worked hard, only to be failed by the system. These people who asked to be heard, only to be met with silence. These citizens who stood up to show what matters to them… beaten down and disowned by the establishment."

As per the latest buzz, The star added, “Are these not the children of Mother India? If not them, for whom do we build, and whose future do we claim to protect? Those who demand ‘organisation’ from students protesting education reform, but don’t apply such lofty standards of accountability to established authority; bootlickers, one and all."

In further updates, The CJP-led student protest demanding the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over the alleged NEET paper leak and other examination irregularities has been ongoing for nearly a month. Activist Sonam Wangchuk has also joined the movement and has been on a hunger strike for the past 26 days.

On top of that, On Monday, students marched from their protest site at Jantar Mantar towards Parliament as part of the 'Chalo Sansad' march. During the protest, they faced a lathi-charge, while Delhi Police also used tear gas and other forceful measures to disperse the crowd.

Following the incident, several celebrities, including Bollywood A-listers Salman Khan and Alia Bhatt, have publicly condemned the alleged use of force against the student protesters and extended their support to the movement.

title: Alia Bhatt backs students amid NEET protest in heartfelt note: “Their courage humbles me”

Notably, Calling the students' determination inspiring, Alia shared their actions should encourage society to reflect on whether it is truly listening to the voices of young people. She added, "Their courage humbles me. Their resolve is a mirror held up to all of us, asking whether we are truly listening to the very people who will inherit and shape this country's tomorrow."

As per the latest buzz, She concluded her note by reaffirming that the movement belongs to the students and expressing confidence in the generation that will shape India's future: "For the students. By the students. The future is theirs. Jai Hind."

title: Varun Grover reacts to video of Mumbai cop threatening students with false drug case; applauds GenZ's attitude
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A widely shared video, purportedly showing a member of the Mumbai Police threatening a group of students with implicating them in a false drug case if they attend protests over the NEET paper leak, has sparked a storm.

Adding to this, Varun Grover has rooted for the student protestors for recording the conversation. The video was shared widely on social media, even by the X account of Cockroach Janta Party. Now lyricist Varun Grover has reacted to the same, noting the ‘shocking aspect’ of the cop threatening innocent kids.

Meanwhile, In the video posted by Varun, a policeman is seen threatening a group of students inside the van. He says he will put 50 grams of 'powder' in their pockets and arrest them in a drugs possession case, ruining their lives forever. "If you are seen again here, I will ruin your lives," the policeman tells the students in the video. The student protesters, who were seated in the rear seat of the vehicle, were seen giggling.

Notably, However, he was not aware that one of the students was recording the entire conversation on his mobile camera. Varun Grover noted, “Two things to note in this video apart from the SHOCKING aspect of Mumbai cops threatening to plant drugs on innocent kids. 1. The cluelessness of the boomer cop about being recorded. 2. The chill DGAF attitude of the boy.”
As per the latest buzz, He added, “This gap between authority and disdain for it is the centre of this protest. A unique, new era of dissent in India.”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Varun Grover (@vidushak)

On top of that, A senior government official told HT that after taking a serious note of the video, the state government has ordered a probe against Pawan Sangle, posted as a driver. He has also been suspended from his position until the probe against him is completed.

Several students and citizens had gathered in Mumbai on Wednesday to show solidarity for the ongoing CJP protests in Delhi. Star Ayesha Khan was even detained by the Mumbai police on Wednesday, and she documented the entire incident to detail how she was pushed inside the police van when she had not even uttered a word about the protest. Imran Khan , Alaya F and Jim Sarbh were some other stars who attended the protests in Mumbai.

title: EXCLUSIVE: CBFC asks for 20+ cuts in The India Story; 4.27 minutes of footage deleted; ‘Kisaan aatankvadi’, ‘Sarkar deshdrohi’ dialogues modified
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The India Story was passed with a U/A 16+ certificate by the CBFC (Central Board of Movie Certification). However, the CBFC asked for more than 20 cuts, mostly dialogues. To begin with, a detailed disclaimer was added at the beginning and end of the movie, which increased the movie’s length by 50 seconds. In a dialogue, the percentage of farmers was reduced from 65% to 25%. The ‘offensive words’ used while referring to the farmer community were asked to be modified. Further, ‘inaccurate reference’ about the Endosulfan tragedy in Kerala was asked to be modified. ‘Offensive words’ in a scene in the second half and ‘inappropriate’ references in a courtroom scene at 2 hours were also similarly asked to be modified.

Adding to this, The dialogue ‘ Munh mein dande daal ’ was modified. The dialogue ‘ Desh ke kisaan desh ke ....... Khila ke maar rahe hain’ was asked to be deleted, which reduced the run time by 20 seconds. The dialogues ‘ Kisaan aatankvadi’ and ‘Sarkar deshdrohi’ were modified. At the beginning of the movie, a 15-second-long dialogue about farmers forming 25% of the population was deleted.

Meanwhile, The ‘ Salana 105-2 kilo’ dialogue was modified, while a 14-second-long dialogue of mothers’ milk containing heavy chemical load, leading to cancer in newborn babies, was deleted. An eight-second-long dialogue beginning with ‘ Aapko jab licence’ to ‘ Naya Bharat hai’ was deleted.

Notably, A dialogue regarding fake milk usage was asked to be modified. A 20-second-long dialogue starting with 'Apni RDX waali' to 'jagah milti hai' was deleted. Then a dialogue at the beginning of the second half about Endosulfam, lasting 40 seconds, was deleted. A 20-second-long dialogue starting with 'Kisan doshi hai' was removed. In the post-interval, a dialogue beginning with 'Kisaan annadata hai' , and which is 1 minute and 20 seconds long, was axed by the CBFC. The 'Har saal do' dialogue was modified. Finally, the 'visual of disgust' of the Cancer train and the announcement dialogue of a cancer train running from Bhatinda to Bikaner were asked to be modified.

As per the latest buzz, In short, the CBFC censored 4 minutes and 27 seconds of The India Story . The length of the movie, as mentioned on the censor certificate, is 130.13 minutes. In other words, The India Story is 2 hours, 10 minutes and 13 seconds long.

title: Saanvie Tallwar alleges Karan Kundrra kissed her without consent, slapped her: 'He abused me and my family'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Saanvie Tallwar has accused Karan Kundrra of kissing her without her consent and slapping her while they were working on the television show Yeh Kahan Aa Gaye Hum. She claimed the incident was eventually resolved after producer Ektaa Kapoor intervened, apologised on Karan's behalf and supported her.

Adding to this, Karan Kundrra and Saanvie Tallwar in a still from the show Yeh Kahan Aa Gaye Hum. 'Karan kissed me and I slapped him' Recalling the incident during an interview with Filmibeat, Saanvie shared, "There was a scene in which he had to kiss me and I had to slap him, but the director hadn't clapped action, even before that he kissed me and I slapped him. How can you touch me without my permission. He didn't react at that time, but then he came back in sometime and slapped me hard. There is difference between the intensity in a girl and a man's slap. I fell on the floor and then he abused me and my family. Nobody supported me. Later Ektaa ma'am apologised on Karan's behalf and supported me. She managed to make things easy."
Meanwhile, She further claimed that following the incident, the director of the show was replaced.

Notably, During the conversation, Saanvie shared she usually maintains her distance from her co-stars and crew members on set, and she did the same while working with Karan. According to her, both Karan and the show's director disliked her reserved nature. She further claimed that she felt Karan was interested in her and decided to inform his then-girlfriend, Anusha Dandekar .

As per the latest buzz, She shared, "A girl actually understands what kind of gaze and vibe the boy is doing. We had a common friend, so I decided to convey it to Anusha Dandekar who was Karan's girlfriend back then that Karan was interested in me. But after that, she kept coming to set and monitoring. Soon after, they started making things difficult for me and the whole environment turned toxic."

In further updates, Saanvie further alleged that a few months after the first incident, Karan once again made her feel uncomfortable while filming a romantic scene. According to her, the director deliberately did not call "cut" during the shot. She claimed that after she raised the issue, that director was also replaced. According to the star, two directors were replaced during the show's run.
On top of that, Despite the incidents, Saanvie shared that looking back, she does not harbour any ill feelings towards Karan despite the uncomfortable experiences she claims to have faced.
Yeh Kahan Aa Gaye Hum premiered in 2015 The show starred Karan Kundrra and Saanvie Tallwar in the lead roles. It was produced by Ekta Kapoor and Shobha Kapoor.

title: Anurag Kashyap disowns Bandar, says Bobby Deol film in theatres is ‘not my final cut’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Following the rollout of Bandar in theatres in June 2026, filmmaker Anurag Kashyap has made an honest admission about his directorial, starring Bobby Deol . While the movie has sparked debate over its portrayal of sexual assault and drawn criticism for being misogynistic and weakening the #MeToo movement, the filmmaker says he cannot take responsibility for the version audiences are watching in theatres.

Adding to this, Anurag Kashyap reacted to why he distanced himself from Bandar starring Bobby Deol. Anurag Kashyap says Bandar is not the movie he wanted to rollout During a conversation with comedian Kunal Kamra on his YouTube channel, Anurag Kashyap revealed why he stayed away from promoting Bandar and even discouraged Kunal from watching it. The filmmaker shared, “When I shared don't watch, it's because I can't own up… If you noticed, I didn't give any interviews on the movie. Because whatever came out is not my final cut. So, the criticisms that came the movie's way are quite valid. I wanted to put out something I could stand up for. As a result, I couldn't stand up against the criticisms against the movie," he added.

Meanwhile, Anurag further shared that the movie's biggest issue wasn't with what he shot, but with what was removed during editing. According to him, those changes shifted the movie's message in a way he never intended.

Notably, “Cinematically, everything else is pretty much mine… but they changed it by taking something out. Thus, the perspective has been changed. The tilt has changed a little bit. Whatever was there, was made by me. I shot it. But what they have edited out has really affected the outcome,” he explained.

As per the latest buzz, Anurag Kashyap believes the movie industry has changed drastically over the years, with corporatisation making it harder for directors to protect their creative vision. He shared that when projects get delayed and costs keep rising, filmmakers gradually lose control over their own films. According to him, contracts and legal paperwork no longer carry much weight because once a studio takes over, it is the studio that decides what version of the movie is eventually rolled out.

In further updates, Reflecting on how things were different in the past, he shared producers once backed films because they genuinely believed in the story, sometimes even risking everything they owned. Today, he feels the focus has shifted towards making commercially successful films rather than supporting creative ideas. He also pointed out that with only a handful of major studios dominating the industry, opportunities have become limited, making it increasingly difficult for independent films to get financed and reach audiences.

On top of that, Bandar stars Bobby Deol alongside Sanya Malhotra, Sapna Pabbi and Saba Azad. The movie follows a fading star accused of sexual assault and marks Kashyap's return to the director's chair.

An excerpt from HT review reads, “ Overall, despite losing some momentum in the latter half, Bandar remains an engaging watch. It succeeds because it stays focused on the human cost of an accusation and the circus that follows. In an era where public opinion often arrives before the facts, the movie feels timely and relevant.”

title: Ahan Shetty joins Vikram Bhatt's 1920: Cold Winter; shoot expected to begin in November: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Ahan Shetty is as per reports set to star in Vikram Bhatt's 1920: Cold Winter, marking his first horror movie. The project is shared to begin filming in November.

Adding to this, As per a Mid-Day report, the movie is currently in the scripting stage. A source quoted by the publication claimed that Ahan was looking to diversify his filmography after making his debut with Tadap and of late returning to the big screen with Border 2 .

Meanwhile, "This will be Ahan's first brush with the supernatural genre. He wants to do a variety of roles, after being launched in the romantic action drama Tadap . That's why he is carefully choosing movies that belong to different genres," the source shared.

Notably, The report further shared that Vikram Bhatt and producer Anand Pandit are currently searching for the movie's female lead. They are as per reports looking to cast a reasonably well-known star rather than a newcomer.

As per the latest buzz, If everything goes according to plan, filming is expected to begin in November. Before that, the producer-director duo is shared to travel to Scotland for a location recce. Some portions of the movie are also expected to be shot in Shimla.

In further updates, The 1920 franchise began with the 2008 movie 1920 and has since expanded with 1920: Evil Returns , 1920: London , 1921 , and 1920: Horrors of the Heart . 1920: Cold Winter will mark the sixth chapter in the supernatural horror series.
On top of that, Neither Ahan Shetty nor the makers have officially verified or denied the report so far.
Meanwhile, Ahan will next be seen in director Tinu Desai's Sanki .

title: 'नहीं तो हम...', सुप्रीम कोर्ट मेट्रो स्टेशन बंद होने पर चीफ जस्टिस सूर्यकांत का अल्टीमेटम; क्या कहा
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

फोटो वीडियो शहर चुनें ई- पेपर साइन इन होम राज्य देश क्रिकेट पंडित जी से चैट लाइव स्कोर मनोरंजन बिजनेस करियर विदेश Loan- 5Lac धर्म काम की बात ऑटो राशिफल सावन 2026 एक्सप्लेनर्स लाइफस्टाइल ट्रेंडिंग खबरें चुनाव वीडियो आपके लिए खास वायरल ओपिनियन फोटो क्राइम 'नहीं तो हम...', सुप्रीम कोर्ट मेट्रो स्टेशन बंद होने पर चीफ जस्टिस सूर्यकांत का अल्टीमेटम; क्या कहा Jul 23, 2026 11:38 am IST By Mohammad Azam लाइव हिन्दुस्तान, दिल्ली गुरुवार को सुप्रीम कोर्ट बार एसोसिएशन के अध्यक्ष विकास सिंह ने यह मामला जस्टिस सूर्यकांत के सामने उठाया था। जस्टिस सूर्यकांत ने इस मामले पर जवाब देते हुए कहा कि अगर आज दोपहर तक सुप्रीम कोर्ट मेट्रो स्टेशन को नहीं खोला गया तो वो ऐक्शन लेंगे। दिल्ली के जंतर-मंतर और आसपास के इलाकों में प्रदर्शनकारियों की बढ़ती भीड़ और सुरक्षा को देखते हुए डीएमआरसी ने 16 मेट्रो स्टेशनों को बंद करने का फैसला किया। डीएमआरसी के इस निर्णय पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट के चीफ जस्टिस सूर्यकांत का बयान सामने आया है। सूर्यकांत ने कहा कि अगर आज दोपहर तक सुप्रीम कोर्ट मेट्रो स्टेशन नहीं चालू किया गया तो, सुप्रीम कोर्ट इस मामले में दखल देगा।

Adding to this, बता दें कि गुरुवार को सुप्रीम कोर्ट बार एसोसिएशन के अध्यक्ष विकास सिंह ने यह मामला जस्टिस सूर्यकांत के सामने उठाया था। जस्टिस सूर्यकांत ने इस मामले पर जवाब देते हुए कहा कि अगर आज दोपहर तक सुप्रीम कोर्ट मेट्रो स्टेशन को नहीं खोला गया तो वो ऐक्शन लेंगे।

Meanwhile, इस मामले पर बात करते हुए सुप्रीम कोर्ट बार एसोसिएशन के अध्यक्ष विकास कुमार सिंह ने कहा कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट मेट्रो पर वकीलों और कर्मचारियों की अच्छे से स्क्रीनिंग की जा सकती है, लेकिन मेट्रो स्टेशन को नहीं बंद किया जा सकता है। विकास ने कहा कि मेट्रो स्टेशन बंद होने से वकीलों और सुप्रीम कोर्ट के कर्मचारियों के काम पर असर पड़ रहा है। उन्होंने कहा कि मेट्रो के अंदर ही वकीलों और कर्मचारियों की स्क्रीनिंग कर लें, जिससे कोई दिक्कत नहीं आएगी।

Notably, इस मामले पर बात करते हुए सीजेआई सूर्यकांत ने कहा कि अगर लंच के समय तक इसे खोलने के लिए कुछ नहीं किया गया, तो मैं दखल दूंगा। उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि उन्होनो जजों को निर्देश दिए हैं कि अगर विरोध प्रदर्शन और उनसे जुड़ी समस्याओं की वजह से आज कोई वकील पेश नहीं हो पाता है, तो उनके खिलाफ कोई आदेश ना दिया जाए।

As per the latest buzz, बता दें कि गुरुवार को डीएमआरसी ने सुबह साढ़े सात बजे से दिल्ली के 16 स्टेशनों को बंद रखने का फैसला किया था। जिन स्टेशनों को बंद रखने का फैसला किया गया है, उनमें लोक कल्याण मार्ग, राजीव चौक, पटेल चौक, रामकृष्ण आश्रम मार्ग, बाराखंंबा रोड, सुप्रीम कोर्ट, सेवा तीर्थ, जनपथ, मंडी हाउस, सेंट्रल सेक्रेटेरिएट, आईटीओ, दिल्ली गेट, इंद्रप्रस्थ, खान मार्केट,जोर बाग के साथ शिवाजी स्टेडियम मेट्रे स्टेशन शामिल हैं। इन सभी स्टेशनों को अगले आदेश तक के लिए बंद कर दिया गया है।
In further updates, मोहम्मद आजम पिछले 3.5 सालों से पत्रकारिता कर रहे हैं और वर्तमान में लाइव हिन्दुस्तान में स्टेट टीम में बतौर कंटेंट प्रोडूसर काम कर रहे हैं।

On top of that, परिचय और अनुभव: मोहम्मद आजम पिछले तीन सालों से ज्यादा समय से पत्रकारिता कर रहे हैं। कम समय में आजम ने पत्रकारिता और डिजिटल मीडिया की बारीकियां सीखी हैं और अब भारत के अग्रणी समाचार संस्थान ‘लाइव हिन्दुस्तान’ (हिन्दुस्तान टाइम्स ग्रुप) में स्टेट न्यूज टीम में अपनी सेवाएं दे रहे हैं।

आजम ने ग्रेजुएशन तक विज्ञान की पढ़ाई की है, लेकिन राजनीतिक विषयों में रुचि उनको पत्रकारिता की तरफ खींच लाई। आजम ने अपना पोस्ट ग्रेजुएशन देश के अग्रणी संस्थानों में से एक भारतीय जनसंचार संस्थान से पूरा किया। विज्ञान बैकग्राउंड होने के चलते आजम को फैक्ट आधारित पत्रकारिता करने में महारत हासिल है।

title: बिहार के 9 जिलों में बारिश की...
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

होम वीडियो सर्च वॉच वेब स्टोरीज ई-पेपर टॉप न्यूज़ राज्य-शहर भास्कर इन्वेस्टिगेशन क्रिकेट भास्कर खास DB ओरिजिनल स्पोर्ट्स बॉलीवुड जॉब - एजुकेशन बिजनेस लाइफस्टाइल जीवन मंत्र वुमन देश विदेश राशिफल टेक - ऑटो फेक न्यूज एक्सपोज़ ओपिनियन मधुरिमा मैगजीन यूटिलिटी लाइफ - साइंस मध्य प्रदेश उत्तरप्रदेश राजस्थान बिहार यूपी खास Hindi News Local Bihar Patna Weather News | Bihar Rain Alert 17 Districts Forecast LIVE पटना-बेगूसराय में तेज बारिश, 9 जिलों में अलर्ट: 25 जुलाई के बाद भारी बारिश के आसार; अबतक 37% कम हुई बरसात पटना 59 मिनट पहले कॉपी लिंक पटना-बेगूसराय में गुरुवार दोपहर बारिश हुई। मौसम विभाग ने आज उत्तर बिहार के 9 जिलों में बारिश की संभावना है। मौसम विभाग ने कई जिलों में बारिश का अलर्ट जारी किया है।

Adding to this, वहीं बुधवार को पटना, पूर्णिया, बेगूसराय, खगड़िया, मधेपुरा, सहरसा, सुपौल और जहानाबाद में तेज बारिश हुई। कुछ जिलों में आसमान में बादल छाए रहे। वहीं भोजपुर में ठनका गिरने से 2 लोगों की मौत हो गई। वहीं समस्तीपुर में एक व्यक्ति की मौत ठनका गिरने से हो गई।
Meanwhile, मौसम विज्ञान केंद्र के अनुसार, 25 जुलाई के बाद पटना, समस्तीपुर, वैशाली, भोजपुर, बक्सर, जहानाबाद और आसपास के जिलों में भारी बारिश का पूर्वानुमान है।
Notably, 5 दिनों में जिलों में तेज हवा, भारी बारिश का अलर्ट

As per the latest buzz, मौसम विभाग ने 28 जुलाई तक अररिया, किशनगंज, पूर्णिया, कटिहार, सुपौल, पश्चिमी-पूर्वी चंपारण, मधुबनी, सीतामढ़ी और शिवहर जिले में भारी बारिश की चेतावनी जारी की है। इस दौरान वज्रपात की आशंका जताई गई है। 28 जुलाई को पटना, भोजपुर, बक्सर, गोपालगंज, सारण, वैशाली और सीवान समेत कई जिलों में भारी बारिश होने की संभावना है।
In further updates, पिछले 24 घंटों में सबसे अधिक बारिश मधेपुरा के पुरैनी में 64.2 मिमी हुई। पटना में 2.8 मिमी बारिश दर्ज की गई।

On top of that, फिलहाल, बिहार में मानसून की रफ्तार कमजोर है। राज्य में अब तक 414.4MM बारिश होनी थी, लेकिन सामान्य से 37 प्रतिशत कम यानी 216.6MM बारिश दर्ज की गई है। बारिश की कमी का असर खेती पर दिखने लगा है।

भोजपुर जिले के अलग-अलग थाना क्षेत्र में बुधवार को आकाशीय बिजली गिरने से दो लोगों की मौत हो गई। पहली घटना धनगाई थाना क्षेत्र के गड़हा बधार की है,जहां खेत में काम कर रहे बुजुर्ग किसान की मौत हो गई। मृतक के बेटे मनोज चौधरी ने बताया की बुधवार की शाम वह खेत में मेड़ (आर) बना रहे थे। तभी तेज बारिश शुरू हो गई। उसी दौरान तेज गर्जन के साथ अचानक ठनका उन पर गिर पड़ा। जिससे उनकी घटनास्थल पर ही मौत हो गई।

title: సీజేపీకి మద్దతుగా.. ముంబయిలో నిరసనలు
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

ముంబయి: పరీక్షల్లో అక్రమాలకు వ్యతిరేకంగా సీజేపీ చేపట్టిన ఆందోళనకు మద్దతుగా బుధవారం ముంబయిలో పలు ప్రాంతాల్లో నిరసనలు జరిగాయి. ఈ సందర్భంగా పలువురిని పోలీసులు అదుపులోకి తీసుకున్నారు. దక్షిణ ముంబయిలోని ఓ ట్రాఫిక్‌ కూడలి వద్ద సీనియర్‌ కాంగ్రెస్‌ నేతలను పోలీసులు బలవంతంగా అక్కడి నుంచి తరలించారు.

Adding to this, రాష్ట్ర కాంగ్రెస్‌ అధ్యక్షుడు హర్షవర్ధన్‌ సప్కాల్, కాంగ్రెస్‌ శాసనసభా పక్ష నేత విజయ్‌ వడెట్టివార్, మాజీ మంత్రి నసీమ్‌ ఖాన్‌ తదితర సీనియర్‌ నేతలను దక్షిణ ముంబైలోని రీగల్‌ సినిమా చౌక్‌ వద్ద పోలీసులు అడ్డుకున్నారు. వారు మహారాష్ట్ర బీజేపీ కార్యాలయం వైపు వెళ్తుండగా పోలీసులు నిలిపివేశారు.భాజపా నేతలకు కాంగ్రెస్‌ నాయకులు భారత రాజ్యాంగ ప్రతిని అందజేయాలని భావించారు. పోలీసులు వారిని బలవంతంగా అక్కడి నుంచి తరలించి వ్యాన్లలో కొలాబా పోలీస్‌ స్టేషన్‌కు తీసుకెళ్లారు. నిరసనకారులు ‘మోదీ హటావో, దేశ్‌ బచావో' అంటూ నినాదాలు చేశారు.

Meanwhile, రోజంతా ముంబయిలోని పలు ప్రాంతాల్లో వందలాది మంది ప్రజలు గుమిగూడి ప్రశ్నపత్రం లీక్‌ వ్యవహారంపై నిరసనలు తెలిపారు. నిషేధాజ్ఞలను ఉల్లంఘించడంతో పలువురు నిరసనకారులను పోలీసులు అదుపులోకి తీసుకున్నారు. ఓ అధికారి తెలిపిన వివరాల ప్రకారం, చెంబూర్‌లోని డాక్టర్‌ బాబాసాహెబ్‌ అంబేడ్కర్‌ గార్డెన్‌ వద్దకు భారీ పోలీసు బందోబస్తు మధ్య వందలాది మంది నిరసనకారులు చేరుకున్నారు. పోలీసులు పలువురిని అదుపులోకి తీసుకున్నారు. కొందరిని ఈడ్చుకెళ్లి పోలీసు వాహనాల్లోకి ఎక్కించి స్థానిక పోలీస్‌ స్టేషన్‌కు తరలించారని ప్రత్యక్ష సాక్షులు తెలిపారు. చెంబూర్‌లోని నిరసనకారులు విద్యా వ్యవస్థలో సంస్కరణలు, ప్రశ్నపత్రం లీక్‌పై చర్యలు తీసుకోవాలని డిమాండ్‌ చేస్తూ ప్లకార్డులు పట్టుకున్నారు. పలువురిని అదుపులోకి తీసుకున్న అనంతరం మిగిలిన వారిని పోలీసులు నిరసన స్థలం నుంచి చెదరగొట్టారు. కొందరు నిరసనకారులు తాము డాక్టర్‌ బాబాసాహెబ్‌ అంబేద్కర్‌ గార్డెన్‌కు వెళ్తుండగా పోలీసులు అడ్డుకున్నారని ఆరోపించారు.

Notably, శివసేన (యూబీటీ) ఎమ్మెల్యే ఆదిత్య ఠాక్రే, మహారాష్ట్ర నవనిర్మాణ సేన నేత అమిత్‌ ఠాక్రే నిరసన స్థలానికి చేరుకుని అనంతరం పోలీస్‌ స్టేషన్‌ను సందర్శించారు.అదుపులోకి తీసుకున్న నిరసనకారులను వారి జోక్యంతో విడుదల చేసినట్లు సమాచారం.

As per the latest buzz, దాదర్‌లోని శివాజీ పార్క్‌ వద్ద బురఖా ధరించిన ఓ మహిళ నిరసనలో పాల్గొంటుండగా పోలీసులు ఆమెను అడ్డుకున్నారు. ఎంఎన్‌ఎస్‌ అధినేత రాజ్‌ ఠాక్రే భార్య శర్మిళ ఆమెకు మద్దతుగా వచ్చి పక్కనే కూర్చున్నారు.
In further updates, దాదర్‌లోని శివసేన భవన్‌ వెలుపల పెద్ద సంఖ్యలో ప్రజలు చేరుకుని కేంద్ర విద్యాశాఖ మంత్రి ధర్మేంద్ర ప్రధాన్‌కి, ప్రధానమంత్రి నరేంద్ర మోదీకి వ్యతిరేకంగా నినాదాలు చేశారు.
On top of that, ఎలాంటి అవాంఛనీయ సంఘటనలు జరగకుండా అన్ని నిరసన ప్రాంతాల్లో పోలీసులు భారీగా మోహరించారు.

గమనిక: ఈనాడు.నెట్‌లో కనిపించే వ్యాపార ప్రకటనలు వివిధ దేశాల్లోని వ్యాపారస్తులు, సంస్థల నుంచి వస్తాయి. కొన్ని ప్రకటనలు పాఠకుల అభిరుచిననుసరించి కృత్రిమ మేధస్సుతో పంపబడతాయి. పాఠకులు తగిన జాగ్రత్త వహించి, ఉత్పత్తులు లేదా సేవల గురించి సముచిత విచారణ చేసి కొనుగోలు చ���యాలి. ఆయా ఉత్పత్తులు / సేవల నాణ్యత లేదా లోపాలకు ఈనాడు యాజమాన్యం బాధ్యత వహించదు. ఈ విషయంలో ఉత్తర ప్రత్యుత్తరాలకి తావు లేదు.

title: हनीमून पर उर्मिला मातोंडकर के Ex हसबैंड, पत्नी संग हुए रोमांटिक, PHOTO
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

फेसबुक टि्वटर कैंसिल बुकमार्क कैंसिल हनीमून पर उर्मिला मातोंडकर के Ex हसबैंड, पत्नी संग हुए रोमांटिक, PHOTO आजतक एंटरटेनमेंट डेस्क नई दिल्ली , 23 जुलाई 2026, अपडेटेड 10:38 AM IST 1/8 उर्मिला मातोंडकर के एक्स-हसबैंड मोहसिन अख्तर मीर, निधा भट्ट से दूसरी शादी करके अपनी जिंदगी की नई शुरुआत कर चुके हैं.
Adding to this, उर्मिला मातोंडकर से अलग होने के बाद मोहसिन की निजी जिंदगी फिर से चर्चा में आ गई है, क्योंकि उनकी दूसरी शादी और हनीमून की तस्वीरें काफी वायरल हो रही हैं.
Meanwhile, शादी के बाद मोहसिन हनीमून पर हैं और सोशल मीडिया पर पत्नी के साथ रोमांटिक फोटोज शेयर कर रहे हैं.
Notably, मोहसिन और निधा की हनीमून पिक्चर्स फैन्स का ध्यान खींच रही हैं. फैन्स न्यूलीवेड्स कपल पर भर-भरकर प्यार लुटा रहे हैं.
As per the latest buzz, इंस्टाग्राम पर शेयर की गई फोटोज में मोहसिन और निधा रेस्टोरेंट में डिनर करते दिखाई दे रहे हैं. कपल ने सिर पर कैप लगाई हुई है.
In further updates, मोहसिन और निधा दोनों ही टेबल पर बैठकर रोमांटिक पोज दे रहे हैं. कपल को देखकर साफ पता चल रहा है कि वो एक-दूजे के प्यार में डूबे हुए हैं.
On top of that, फोटोज शेयर करते हुए मोहसिन ने लिखा कि मेरी पसंदीदा लव स्टोरी हमारी है. ये भरोसे, ईमानदारी और वफादारी पर बनी है. मैं तुमसे बेइंतहा प्यार करता हूं.
उर्मिला मातोंडकर और कश्मीरी बिजनेसमैन-मॉडल मोहसिन अख्तर मीर 4 फरवरी 2016 को शादी के बंधन में बंधे थे. शादी के 8 साल बाद 2024 में दोनों तलाक लेकर अलग हो गए.

title: 'ನನಗೆ 2 ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್ ಸಾಕು, ಮಸೀದಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದರೆ ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ ನವರನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಬಹುದು': ಇಕ್ಬಾಲ್ ಅನ್ಸಾರಿ
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Copied ಕೊಪ್ಪಳ: ಮಾಜಿ ಶಾಸಕ ಇಕ್ಬಾಲ್ ಅನ್ಸಾರಿ ಕೊಪ್ಪಳ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆಯ ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ ನಾಯಕರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ತೀವ್ರ ಅಸಮಾಧಾನವನ್ನು ಬಹಿರಂಗವಾಗಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಪಡಿಸಿದ್ದು ಸುದ್ದಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ತಮ್ಮ ಎರಡು ಸೋಲುಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೊಪ್ಪಳ, ಕನಕಗಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಯಲಬುರ್ಗಾ ಭಾಗದ ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ ನಾಯಕರೇ ಕಾರಣ ಎಂದು ಇಕ್ಬಾಲ್ ಅನ್ಸಾರಿ ಆರೋಪಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
Adding to this, ಮಾಜಿ ಸಿಎಂ ಸಿದ್ದರಾಮಯ್ಯ ಅವರನ್ನು ನಾನು ನಂಬಿ ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ ಸೇರಿರುವುದಾಗಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟಪಡಿಸಿದ ಅನ್ಸಾರಿ, ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಟಿಕೆಟ್ ನೀಡಿದರೂ, ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ನಾಯಕರ ಪಿತೂರಿಯಿಂದ ನಾನು ಸೋಲಬೇಕಾಯಿತು ಎಂದು ಆರೋಪಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

Meanwhile, ಇಕ್ಬಾಲ್ ಅನ್ಸಾರಿ ಬಿಜೆಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂದು ಗಾಳಿ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಹಬ್ಬಿಸಿದರು. ಗಾಳಿ ಸುದ್ದಿಯನ್ನು ನಂಬಿ ಜನರು ಅದನ್ನು ನಂಬಿದರೆ ಅವರಷ್ಟು ಹುಚ್ಚರು ಬೇರೊಬ್ಬರಿಲ್ಲ. ಸತ್ಯತೆ ಏನಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು. ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ ನನ್ನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅನುಮಾನ ಮೂಡುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಹೊರಗೆ ದಬ್ಬುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು. ನಾನು ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇರೆ ಪಕ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತೇನೆ ಎಂದು ಎಂದಾದರೂ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದೆನಾ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಶ್ನಿಸಿದರು.

Notably, ನನಗೆ ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ ನಾಯಕರನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸೋಕೆ ಎರಡು ನಿಮಿಷ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಎರಡು ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್ ಸಾಕು. ಶುಕ್ರವಾರ ಮಸೀದಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ನನ್ನನ್ನು ಈ ರೀತಿ ಸೋಲಿಸಿದರು, ಇವರಿಗೆ ಮತ ಹಾಕಬೇಡಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸ ಯಾರು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೋ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಮತ ಹಾಕಿ ಎಂದು ಮನವಿ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಸಾಕು ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಬಹುದು. ಆದರೆ ತಾನು ದೈವ ಭಕ್ತನಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡಲು ಇಚ್ಛಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ತಾವು ಈಗಲೂ ಕಾಂಗ್ರೆಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಇದ್ದು, ಸತ್ಯಾಸತ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಜನರು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಅನ್ಸಾರಿ ಮನವಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡರು.

Meanwhile, यह मामला उस समय देशभर में चर्चा का विषय बना था, जब शादी के कुछ समय बाद हनीमून पर गए इंदौर निवासी राजा रघुवंशी की हत्या हो गई थी. मामले में उनकी पत्नी सोनम रघुवंशी, उसके प्रेमी समेत कई लोगों को आरोपी बनाया गया है. बाद में सोनम को जमानत मिलने के खिलाफ मेघालय सरकार ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट का दरवाजा खटखटाया था.

Notably, मेघालय सरकार ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट में दायर अपनी याचिका में कहा था कि सोनम रघुवंशी को मिली जमानत उचित नहीं है और इसे रद्द किया जाना चाहिए. राज्य सरकार की ओर से पेश सॉलिसिटर जनरल तुषार मेहता ने दलील दी कि जमानत आदेश एक तकनीकी आधार पर मिला और इसे बरकरार रखना उचित नहीं होगा. उन्होंने अदालत से कहा कि गिरफ्तारी से जुड़े दस्तावेज में केवल एक कानूनी धारा का नंबर टाइप करने में त्रुटि हुई थी. इतनी छोटी तकनीकी गलती के आधार पर आरोपी को जमानत नहीं मिलनी चाहिए. उन्होंने यह भी आशंका जताई कि यदि जमानत जारी रहती है तो आरोपी के फरार होने की संभावना से इनकार नहीं किया जा सकता.

As per the latest buzz, पिछली सुनवाई के दौरान सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने सोनम रघुवंशी के वकील के सामने दो विकल्प रखे थे. अदालत ने पूछा था कि क्या सोनम स्वेच्छा से सरेंडर करेंगी या फिर अदालत उनकी जमानत रद्द करने पर फैसला सुनाए. इसके बाद मामले की अगली सुनवाई में सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने जमानत रद्द करते हुए सोनम रघुवंशी को तीन सप्ताह के भीतर सरेंडर करने का निर्देश दे दिया.

In further updates, सुनवाई के दौरान सोनम रघुवंशी के वकील ने जमानत बनाए रखने की मांग करते हुए कई तर्क रखे. उन्होंने अदालत को बताया कि इस मामले में कुल 94 गवाह बनाए गए हैं, लेकिन अब तक केवल चार गवाहों के बयान दर्ज हुए हैं. उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि मामले में सप्लीमेंट्री चार्जशीट भी दाखिल हो चुकी है और सोनम को कड़ी शर्तों के साथ जमानत मिली थी. बचाव पक्ष ने अदालत को यह भी बताया कि सोनम सभी शर्तों का पालन कर रही हैं और उनके फरार होने की कोई आशंका नहीं है.

On top of that, सोनम के वकील ने एक और महत्वपूर्ण दलील दी. उन्होंने कहा कि यह कहना गलत है कि सोनम ने आत्मसमर्पण किया था. बचाव पक्ष के अनुसार, सोनम को उत्तर प्रदेश के गाजीपुर से गिरफ्तार किया गया था. इसलिए यह कहना कि उन्होंने स्वयं सरेंडर किया था, तथ्यात्मक रूप से सही नहीं है.

राज्य सरकार की ओर से पेश सॉलिसिटर जनरल तुषार मेहता ने इस दलील का विरोध किया. उन्होंने अदालत में कहा कि गिरफ्तारी के आधार (Ground of Arrest) को लेकर उठाई गई आपत्ति का कोई ठोस आधार नहीं है. उनका कहना था कि रिकॉर्ड और चार्जशीट में यह दर्ज है कि आरोपी ने सरेंडर किया था. साथ ही उन्होंने दोहराया कि तकनीकी त्रुटि के आधार पर मिली जमानत को जारी नहीं रखा जाना चाहिए.

title: Raj Kundra bought Rajasthan Royals for ₹82 cr as a Valentine's Day gift for Shilpa Shetty, it's not worth ₹16000 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Raj Kundra of late opened up about the time he acquired a majority stake in IPL franchise Rajasthan Royals . The businessman opened up that he bought the team as a Valentine's Day gift for his wife, star Shilpa Shetty .

Adding to this, Shilpa Shetty and Raj Kundra . 'Bought it like a Valentine's Day gift' In conversation with the YouTube channel SMTV, Raj opened up that he acquired his stake in the franchise in 2009. "I bought it like a Valentine's Day gift. I thought Shilpa had the brand value and I am putting in the money. I bought my stake then, but the case is still going on," he shared.

Meanwhile, During the interaction, Raj shared that when he invested in the IPL team, its valuation was around ₹ 700 crore rupees. According to him, the franchise is now valued at nearly ₹ 16,000 crore rupees. Reports at the time shared that Raj had spent around ₹ 81.9 crore rupees to acquire his stake in Rajasthan Royals.

Notably, For the unversed, in 2013, Rajasthan Royals co-owner Raj Kundra was accused of illegal betting during the Indian Premier League (IPL). Following an investigation by the Supreme Court-appointed Justice Lodha Committee, he was banned for life from all cricket-related activities in 2015, while Rajasthan Royals was suspended from the IPL for two seasons (2016 and 2017).

As per the latest buzz, Raj shared he was associated with the team for five to six years before he was "accused of betting." Recalling the row, he shared, "We were then accused of betting and betting is not allowed. Then the team was banned for two years. Some players were banned for fixing and as owners, we were banned for betting. What was that betting? It was like you and me sitting with each other. We would be like, 'Lagi shart? (Want to bet?)' That was the conversation. 'Lagi 500 ki shart? (Want to bet for 500?)'. They shared even that is not allowed. And we thought, you are banning us for this? The case is still sub judice with the Supreme Court."
In further updates, Raj also claimed that he was the only one among the Rajasthan Royals owners who was held responsible in the case.

On top of that, He further spoke about the business side of the IPL, saying that franchise owners did not make significant profits during the first five to six years of the tournament. According to him, teams either broke even or had to invest additional money to sustain operations.

Explaining how the league's financial model has evolved, Raj shared that owners now earn substantially higher revenues. He claimed that nearly 70 percent of a franchise's earnings come from the broadcasting deal, while around 10-15 percent comes from jersey sponsorships and another 10-15 percent from ticket sales. Raj went on to claim that every IPL franchise now earns an annual profit of approximately ₹ 200-500 crore rupees.

title: Salman Khan REACTS to NEET protest violence, urges government to support students: “It should not be hijacked politically”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Salman Khan reacts to the NEET protests, supports students, condemns violence, and says the movement should not be hijacked politically.
Adding to this, Salman Khan expresses support for students protesting over NEET

Meanwhile, Sharing his thoughts, Salman wrote, "It was such a peaceful movement. Feel so sad that it had to take a violent turn. My heart goes out to the students and their families who were hurt. Paper leak is a very serious issue, and I am glad to know and see that the kids of our country have come together for a better educational system, and their parents supported them."

Notably, The star lauded the students for raising their voices through peaceful means and shared their determination to improve the education system deserved appreciation. "I truly appreciate the stand they have taken, showing dedication, sincerity and keenness to study hard and make their future and a greater, educated India. This andolan, this protest, is the right way to go about it, and the students have done this peacefully. So courageous and brave. Driven and motivated towards education, this generation will make India proud," he wrote.
As per the latest buzz, Salman Khan urges NEET protesters to remain free from political influence

In further updates, Salman also stressed that the issue should remain centred on students and education rather than political interests. "This issue is between the students and the educational system. It should not be hijacked politically. The credit should only go to the students of our country, and I am sure the government will also give them all the support and make it a stronger educational system. It's a win-win situation. Hoping and praying for a positive decision. God bless all of you who want to be educated," he added.

title: After getting trolled by FTII students, R Madhavan shows support for CJP-led protest
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A day after star and Movie and Television Institute of India ( FTII ) chairman R Madhavan was mocked by students of the institute for his silence on the NEET paper leak and the ongoing Cockroach Janata Party (CJP)-led protests in Delhi, the star has broken his silence on the issue and expressed solidarity with the students.

Adding to this, R Madhavan supports student protest. (Instagram/ R Madhavan) 'Let the consequences be firm' Madhavan took to his Instagram Stories to express his support for the students. He wrote, “As someone who has always believed in the limitless potential of India's youth, I share the concern and disappointment felt by so many students and parents today. An education system must inspire confidence, fairness, and opportunity. Incidents such as examination paper leaks undermine that trust and can deeply affect the hopes, hard work, and dreams of countless young people and their families, especially in a country like India, where education plays such a defining role in shaping lives.”

Meanwhile, He added, “I urge the government to ensure that every individual found responsible is brought to justice swiftly and decisively. Let the consequences be so firm and unambiguous that no one ever dares to jeopardize the future of our youth again."

Notably, However, Madhavan also expressed faith in the government's ability to address the issue. He wrote, “Having acknowledged lapses in the past regarding this incident, I have faith that our government will take the necessary corrective measures, strengthen the system, and safeguard the integrity of education for generations to come. Your talent, perseverance, and character are far greater than the shortcomings of any system. Continue to work hard, believe in yourselves, and never allow temporary setbacks to define your future.”

As per the latest buzz, The star, however, cautioned the students to remain vigilant against those who might try to exploit the movement for their own interests. “I admire the grit and determination of those who are peacefully asking for meaningful reforms. At the same time, I would urge everyone to remain vigilant against vested interests that may attempt to hijack your cause and divert it from its true purpose,” he shared.

In further updates, Of late, an image of Madhavan's cabin door at the Movie and Television Institute of India (FTII) surfaced on social media. A "Gayab" meme was pasted on his cabin door alongside a poster that read, "NEET for Sale". The posters were seen as a reference to the star's silence over the ongoing protests in Delhi against the alleged NEET paper leak.

On top of that, For the unversed, activist Sonam Wangchuk had been on a 26-day hunger strike demanding the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over alleged examination irregularities, including the NEET paper leak. The protest was backed by the CJP. On Monday, CJP-led student protesters marched from Jantar Mantar to Parliament as part of their 'Chalo Sansad' protest. During the march, the students faced a lathi-charge, while police also used tear gas to disperse the crowd.

title: Naseeruddin Shah SLAMS PM Narendra Modi over NEET protests, says, "Has he accepted responsibility for any blunders?"
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Naseeruddin Shah criticises PM Narendra Modi's handling of the NEET protest row, saying he is not surprised by the government's response.

Adding to this, When asked how he viewed the Prime Minister's response to what was described as one of the most serious issues of his tenure, Shah shared he was not surprised. "I'm not surprised at all. When has he spoken honestly about anything? Has he accepted responsibility for any of his blunders? Has he ever accepted the fact that he was perhaps wrong? No. He's divine, and this supposed divinity of his has affected all his followers," Shah shared.

Meanwhile, The star went on to question what he described as a lack of accountability, while referring to several statements made by the Prime Minister in the past. "It's amazing to hear and see the magic he seems to have performed. He talks about gutter gas to a group of scientists who applaud. He talks about Lord Ganesha's head being the result of plastic surgery, Karna and the Kauravas being IVF-born, and he's applauded by doctors. What is happening to us? Is there no one who is ever going to question this man?" he shared.

Notably, Shah also criticised the Prime Minister for not holding press conferences, claiming he avoids difficult questions. "He never speaks to the press because he's scared. He'll be asked about 2002. He'll be asked about his supposed 35 years of begging, meditating in the Himalayas, and travelling abroad before he entered politics," he alleged.

As per the latest buzz, Continuing his criticism, the veteran star questioned the Prime Minister's public messaging and actions. "He tells us to save petrol and drives around in a convoy of SUVs. He tells us not to travel abroad and then leaves on foreign tours. I find it difficult to take anything he says seriously," Shah shared.

In further updates, When the interviewer remarked that, in his view, the Prime Minister appeared to be "a fraud," Shah responded, "Well, he's very close to being one, but I find it difficult to take anything he says seriously."

On top of that, Shah's latest remarks come shortly after he shared an emotional Instagram video expressing anger over the police action against students protesting over the alleged NEET paper leak. In that video, he shared he was "boiling with anger" after watching footage of security personnel using force on demonstrators and compared the masked officers to American ICE agents.
A post shared by Naseeruddin Shah (@naseeruddin49)

title: Rajkummar Rao deletes comment on participating in 'Modi Hai Toh Mumkin Hai' song, sparks debate
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
A now-deleted comment by star Rajkummar Rao has sparked fresh discussion over his participation in last year's ‘Modi Hai’ song.

Adding to this, Rajkummar Rao was among the dozen actors from Bollywood who participated in the Modi Hai Toh Mumkin Hai song. On Wednesday, Rao posted on Instagram to voice support for the ongoing students' protest in New Delhi, spearheaded by the Cockroach Janta Party. In the comments section, a user asked him about participating in “Modi Hai Toh Mumkin Hai”, which also featured other Bollywood celebrities.
Meanwhile, Rao responded to the user, but soon deleted the comment that stirred a social media conversation. Several users took screenshots of the same before it was taken down.

Notably, On Rajkummar's post, user @om.ar510 commented, “I had huge respect for you man... you lost it with one propaganda song!!! I never miss any of your movies, never thought you would sold off so easily, you were supposed to lead the new generation of artists... instead!!!”

As per the latest buzz, The now-deleted comment included the line, "You can never know the pressure." The remark prompted some social media users to speculate that Rao was referring to pressure to participate in the 'Modi Hai' song. However, the star neither elaborated on what he meant nor explicitly shared he had been forced or pressured into taking part in the song. As long as my conscience is clean and I work the hardest nothing else matters. People who know me personally know who I am and hopefully one day I’ll be able to earn back your respect. title: Sunny Deol's Partition saga Batwara 1947 cleared by CBFC without cuts: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Batwara 1947, the soon-to-release historical drama starring Sunny Deol and directed by Rajkumar Santoshi , has as per reports been cleared by the Central Board of Movie Certification ( CBFC ) without any cuts. The movie is set around the Partition and tells the tale of a Muslim family in Lahore who come face-to-face with a Hindu woman refusing to leave her ancestral home.

Adding to this, Batwara 1947 reunites Sunny Deol with Preity Zinta. Batwara 1947 cleared by the CBFC News agency ANI cited sources as saying the movie has received a CBFC certificate with zero cuts. Now, with the censor certification, the Rajkumar Santoshi directorial is set for its scheduled theatrical rollout on August 14.

Meanwhile, Batwara 1947 is based on a Mohajir family that crosses over to Lahore and occupies an abandoned Hindu home after the Partition. Based on acclaimed playwright Asghar Wajahat's play Jis Lahore Nai Vekhya, O Jamya E Nai, the narrative focuses on an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave the house and the issues that arise between the Mohajir family and her. The movie celebrates the bonding of two families while talking about hope in one of the darkest chapters of human history.

Notably, Batwara 1947, previously titled Lahore 1947, stars Sunny Deol as the patriarch of the Mohajir family, with Shabana Azmi playing a Hindu woman stranded in Pakistan who refuses to leave her ancestral home.

As per the latest buzz, The makers of 'Batwara 1947' of late unveiled a new poster of the movie and revealed its rollout date. The newly rolled out poster features an idol of Lord Krishna with a lit diya in the foreground, set against the backdrop of the Partition of India in 1947. Along with the poster, the makers wrote, “When the world chose sides, HE chose dharma. Watch #Batwara1947 in cinemas this Partition Day, 14th August.”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Aamir Khan Productions (@aamirkhanproductions)

On top of that, Directed by Rajkumar Santoshi, the movie is backed by Aamir Khan Productions. Apart from Sunny and Shabana, the movie also stars Preity Zinta, Karan Deol, Ali Fazal, Abhimanyu Singh, Khhushi Hajare, and Kanikka Kapur. Batwara 1947 marks Preity's return to acting after over half a decade. The music for the movie has been composed by AR Rahman, with lyrics by Javed Akhtar.

title: Alia Bhatt breaks silence on CJP protests: ‘Last few days have broken my heart’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After Salman Khan, Alia Bhatt has come out in support of the CJP-led student protest in Delhi. The Bollywood A-lister is among the growing number of celebrities who have voiced support for the students after they faced lathi-charge during their protest march on Monday.

Adding to this, Alia Bhatt has put up a post about the students' protest all around the country. (PTI) Alia Bhatt supports students Taking to Instagram, Alia shared a heartfelt note in support of the students. It read, "The last few days have broken my heart and then mended it, again and again, with hope. Behind every student standing their ground is a dream, a family's hope, a journey of countless sacrifices. They represent not just themselves but everyone who has supported them, while creating a better path for those who will come after them."

Meanwhile, Praising the students for their courage and determination, Alia further wrote, “Their courage humbles me. Their resolve is a mirror held up to all of us, asking whether we are truly listening to the very people who will inherit and shape this country's tomorrow. For the students. By the students. The future is theirs Jai Hind.”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by αlia bhatt 💛 (@aliaabhatt)

As per the latest buzz, Alia Bhatt isn't the first Bollywood A-list star to back the students. On Wednesday night, Salman Khan also expressed solidarity with the protesters. He took to social media and shared a message in support of the movement. Salman posted a photo of himself as a young student and wrote, "It was such a peaceful movement, feel so sad that it had to take a violent turn. My heart goes out to the students and their families who were hurt. Paper leak is a very serious issue, and I am glad to know n see that the kids of our country have come together for a better educational system, and their parents supported them."

In further updates, He added, "I truly appreciate the stand they have taken, showing dedication, sincerity, and keenness to study hard n make their future and a greater, educated India. This andolan, this protest, is the right way to go abt it, n the students have done this peacefully. So courageous and brave. Driven and motivated towards education, this generation will make India proud."
On top of that, The star also shared that the movement should not be hijacked politically and that the credit should go only to the students of the country.

Apart from Salman and Alia, Huma Qureshi also reached the Jantar Mantar protest site with her brother, Saqib Saleem, in the early hours of Thursday, July 23, 2026, at around 2 am, to extend their support to the students. Over the past few days, several actors, including Rajkummar Rao, Prakash Raj, Naseeruddin Shah, Anupam Kher, Shabana Azmi and Javed Akhtar, have also expressed solidarity with the protesting students.

title: Kangana Ranaut says she's ‘never seen an atheist topper’ as she praises NEET AIR 20 Vaishnavi Das
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MP Kangana Ranaut has been closely following the developments around the nationwide NEET protests. Amid the ongoing debate over the examination, she took a moment to celebrate a story by applauding NEET UG 2026 topper Vaishnavi Das. Kangana re-shared a video of Vaishnavi's interview on her Instagram Stories after it gained attention online. She secured All India Rank (AIR) 20 with an outstanding score of 700 out of 720. In her interview, she opened up that she was with her parents celebrating Rath Yatra when the NEET results were revealed. Reacting to Vaishnavi's mention of Rath Yatra, Kangana shared her own thoughts on faith.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut backs NEET AIR 20 Vaishnavi Das, says she's never seen an atheist topper amid student protests. (Rahul Singh) Kangana Ranaut reacts to Vaishnavi Das' interview Sharing the video on her Instagram Stories, Kangana wrote, “Never seen or met an atheist topper/winner. They always know hard work was theirs but grace came from else.” This reaction of Kangana came after Vaishnavi shared how he discovered her results.

Meanwhile, During her interview with ANI, Vaishnavi Das, a Hyderabad-based student, recalled that she was with her parents, celebrating Rath Yatra, when the NEET results were declared. What began as a regular family outing soon turned into one of the happiest moments of their lives. “I was not at home when the results came out. I was in the car with my parents as it was Rath Yatra, and since I am Odia, we had gone to see the celebrations. We had just passed the temple when the results were rolled out, I screamed ‘20’ to my parents. We stopped the car on the side of the road and just sat there. I cried, and the entire journey felt unbelievable. It is still sinking in,” she added.

Notably, In conversation with the same news agency earlier this week, Kangana Ranaut also spoke amid the ongoing monsoon sessions and shared that the Parliament is the right place to debate every issue and hold the government accountable. “Our parliamentary session is on — so that we can discuss all issues in detail, and the government is held accountable for everything. That is its purpose, and we want the session to proceed and for them to raise their questions there, but if they create a ruckus and cause chaos there, as they are doing with this protest, then that is not right,” she shared, according to news agency ANI.

As per the latest buzz, The star-MP also criticised attempts to pressure the government into taking decisions amid the demands to sack Dharmendra Pradhan from the Education Minister position. “You cannot arm-twist the government into deciding who to sack and who to keep. This arm-twisting is not good," Ranaut shared.

In further updates, Vaishnavi Das' achievement has come at a time when NEET remains one of the most talked-about issues in the country. The row began after allegations of a paper leak triggered outrage among lakhs of medical aspirants, with many questioning the credibility and fairness of the entrance exam. The conversation soon widened beyond the examination itself. Reports of several students dying by suicide amid the immense pressure of preparing for NEET sparked fresh concerns about the mental health of young aspirants and the need for greater accountability in the education system.

On top of that, As the anger grew, a satirical citizens' movement called the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) came into the spotlight. The name was inspired by a remark in which Chief Justice of India Surya Kant allegedly referred to unemployed youth activists as "cockroaches." Instead of backing down, many students embraced the label as a symbol of protest. What started online quickly turned into demonstrations on the ground, with students, parents, teachers and supporters gathering at Delhi's Jantar Mantar and several other cities.

The protesters have put forward a list of demands, including the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, ₹ 1 crore rupees compensation for the families of students who died by suicide, and the rollout of activist Sonam Wangchuk, who was forcibly taken to a hospital while observing an indefinite hunger strike at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi.

title: US-India Satellite Delivers Data, Reveals ‘Hummingbird’ in Antarctica
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Earth . 4 min read US-India Satellite Delivers Data, Reveals ‘Hummingbird’ in Antarctica Jet Propulsion Laboratory https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/ July 21, 2026 Scientists used data from the L-band radar aboard the U.S.-India Earth-orbiting NISAR satellite to produce this image of Nunatak Zaterjavshijsja, a mountaintop in East Antarctica, poking out amid a stream of ice flowing northeast to the ocean.

Adding to this, The image shows Nunatak Zaterjavshijsja at center-left, surrounded by ice fractured with crevasses, which are shown as sharp, green lines. The magenta portions of the image represent more regular surfaces, such as smooth ice.
Meanwhile, Data from NISAR, one of the most powerful radar systems ever launched, is now available to the world. A vivid image of Antarctic ice showcases what the satellite can do.

Notably, As of July 20, the public can access data from the two powerful radar instruments aboard the NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) satellite. Teams in the United States and India will rollout files processed from the satellite’s L-band and S-band radars on an ongoing basis, helping researchers and other users track the movement of Earth’s land and ice masses, monitor changes in ecosystems like forests and wetlands, and respond to natural hazards such as landslides and earthquakes.

As per the latest buzz, The rollout comes as NASA and ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) prepare to celebrate the first anniversary of NISAR’s July 30, 2025 , launch from India’s Satish Dhawan Space Centre. Since that time, the mission engineering and science teams have been busy calibrating instrumentation, refining algorithms, and monitoring nearly all the planet’s land- and ice-covered surfaces twice every 12 days. Along the way, the team has captured scenes from around the globe — urban street grids , agricultural fields , landslides , earthquakes , and sinking land in Mexico City .

In further updates, An early image rolled out Tuesday revealed the fractured, barren surface of an Antarctic landscape in stark detail. In a merging of science and serendipity, it also resembles something else entirely: a hummingbird.

On top of that, Despite its otherworldly quality, the Antarctic image shows a very real geographical feature called Nunatak Zaterjavshijsja, a mountaintop in East Antarctica, poking out amid a stream of ice flowing northeast to the ocean. As the moving glacier passes the obstruction, the mountain’s topography causes stresses in the ice, heavily fracturing the surrounding surfaces with deep cracks, called crevasses, which show as sharp green lines in the image.

“First, it’s a beautiful image, with rich details of features that provide insights to how the glacier is moving. Then, because radar can often see through snow and deep into the ice, NISAR can observe fundamentally different properties of Antarctic ice than can be seen in optical imagery,” shared Seongsu Jeong, the signal analysis engineer who produced the image at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California. “With NISAR we’re seeing what’s hidden beneath the surface.”

title: Video of Salman Khan admitting to getting leaked exam papers resurfaces after he backs students over protest crackdown
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood Salman Khan became one of the biggest stars of the country on Wednesday night who weighed in on the alleged NEET paper leak row and the protests across the country led by Cockroach Janta Party (CJP). He lent his support to students who have been protesting against the row. Calling paper leaks a "very serious issue”, the star expressed sadness over the injuries sustained by students during July 20th protests demonstrations and shared the focus should remain on improving the country's education system. As his statement sparked conversation online, many were also reminded of a funny story Salim Khan once shared about Salman and leaked exam papers from his school days.

Adding to this, Salman Khan's support for protesting students puts old leaked exam papers video back in focus. (PTI) When Salim Khan joked about Salman and leaked exam papers Salman's remarks have also reminded many followers of a story shared by his father, Salim Khan, during an appearance on The Kapil Sharma Show with Salman Khan, Arbaaz Khan and Sohail Khan back in 2020,

Meanwhile, Recalling the incident, Salim shared there was once a man named Ganesh who received special treatment whenever he visited their home. “‘Ganesh aaya hai’, ‘Ganesh ko chai pilao’, ‘Arre, Ganesh ke liye kursi le aao baithne ke liye’... Maine kaha yeh Ganesh kaun hai? Mere se zyada izzat milti hai isko iss ghar mein (I would hear ‘Ganesh has come’, ‘Get some tea for Ganesh’, ‘Get a chair for Ganesh to sit’. I would wonder who this Ganesh is, who is getting more respect than me in the house),” he recalled.

Notably, He then delivered the punchline that left everyone on the show laughing. "Pata laga jab exam ka paper leak hota tha, woh inko laake deta tha (I found out that he would give leaked exam papers to them)," Salim shared.

As per the latest buzz, As the audience burst into laughter, Sohail Khan joked that family secrets were now coming out. Kapil Sharma teased him, saying, “Sohail bhai, bade shararati rahe hai aap (you have been quite naughty)!” Salman then admitted with a smile, “Nahi, mera wala tha woh (This story is about me).”

In further updates, Soon after the video resurfaced on social media, internet was quick to point out the star's hypocrisy. A reddit user wrote, “Yes he is a hypocrite and cheating is probably the least bad thing he has done. But that doesn't change the fact that Dharmendra Pradhan needs to resign.”

On top of that, Another user on X shared, “Internet is a bloody damn karma place.” One internet user shared, “Celebs and their hypocrisy.” One pointed out, “India is a comedy country. Here you can leak paper and then make jokes about it (more importantly without consequences.) If at all, youth should be angry over this but everyone in show was laughing.”

Salman Khan on Wednesday voiced his support for students through a post on all his social media platforms, calling the alleged paper leak a serious concern and praising young people for peacefully demanding a better education system. “It was such a peaceful movement, feel so sad that it had to take a violent turn. My heart goes out to the students and their families who were hurt. Paper leak is a very serious issue, and I am glad to know and see that the kids of our country have come together for a better educational system, and their parents supported them," the star wrote.
